name: @simra/agent-stats
description: Agent Stats — per-agent and per-agent × model cost, prompts and steps for OpenChamber, styled like the built-in stats page.

scripts.build: npx openchamber-guest-bundle panel/main.ts panel/main.js && npx openchamber-guest-bundle --node service/main.ts service/main.js
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --lib es2022,dom panel/main.ts service/main.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npx openchamber-guest-check
